title: Farm
description: Mutable farm profile. Uses field-level Lamport clocks for offline conflict resolution: two offline edits to different fields both survive; same field follows last-write-wins.

name.description: Farm name or owner name as used locally.

owner_phone.description: Verified phone number (E.164, India only for v1). Used for OTP auth and SMS alerts.

location.description: Farm location for regional analytics and lab directory lookup.

geo_accuracy_m.description: GPS accuracy in metres at time of location capture.

language_preference.description: Language enum key. App switches to this language on farm profile load.

fpo_id.description: Linked FPO/co-operative for dashboard aggregation and device sharing.

photo_url.description: Optional farm photo stored in MinIO.

consent.description: DPDP Act 2023 consent record. Must be obtained before any data leaves the device.

fields.description: Field-level Lamport clock map. Every top-level mutable field has an entry here. Format: { 'field_name': { 'device': 'AAHAR-P-004821', 'counter': 42 } }. Used by sync engine for conflict resolution.

notes.description: Optional notes by the FPO supervisor or vet.
